name: feishu-ai-pm
description: 只记录、整理和管理数据需求的 Windows 个人 AI PM
author: guanchen-dotcom

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @ai-pm/server" "npm run dev -w @ai-pm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-pm/web && npm run build -w @ai-pm/server && npm run build -w @ai-pm/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-pm/server && npm run typecheck -w @ai-pm/web && npm run typecheck -w @ai-pm/desktop
scripts.check:runtime: npm run test:e2e:matcher && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:desktop-build-artifact && node scripts/e2e-build-provenance.mjs write
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run docs:test && npm run ci:policy:test && npm run check:runtime
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run check && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:smoke: npm run check && npx electron --version && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config.appId=com.guanchen.feishu-ai-pm.smoke --config.productName=Data-PM-Smoke --config.nsis.guid=28b726ad-6cc1-4f06-8c91-16e6f74d1c0b --config.directories.output=tmp/smoke-release --config.nsis.createDesktopShortcut=false --config.nsis.createStartMenuShortcut=false
